\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 282-285 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R290-first-pass-words-from-chapters-282-285}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a chenda drum and a pooram.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item importance, an event, safety, an attempt, success
  \item urgent, important, safe, temporary, directly
  \item huge, size, interesting, boring, dangerous
  \item flat, wrinkled, steep, hollow, faded
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Importance? (\textbf{\ml{പ്രാധാന്യം}}, \emph{prādhānyaṁ}.) An event? (\textbf{\ml{സംഭവം}}, \emph{sambhavaṁ}.) Safety? (\textbf{\ml{സുരക്ഷ}}, \emph{surakṣa}.) An attempt? (\textbf{\ml{ശ്രമം}}, \emph{śramaṁ}.) Success? (\textbf{\ml{വിജയം}}, \emph{vijayaṁ}.) Urgent? (\textbf{\ml{അടിയന്തര}}, \emph{aṭiyantara}.) Important? (\textbf{\ml{പ്രധാനപ്പെട്ട}}, \emph{pradhānappeṭṭa}.) Safe? (\textbf{\ml{സുരക്ഷിതമായ}}, \emph{surakṣitamāya}.) Temporary? (\textbf{\ml{താൽക്കാലിക}}, \emph{tālkkālika}.) Directly? (\textbf{\ml{നേരിട്ട്}}, \emph{nēriṭṭŭ}.) Huge? (\textbf{\ml{കൂറ്റൻ}}, \emph{kūṟṟan}.) Size? (\textbf{\ml{വലിപ്പം}}, \emph{valippaṁ}.) Interesting? (\textbf{\ml{രസകരമായ}}, \emph{rasakaramāya}.) Boring? (\textbf{\ml{വിരസമായ}}, \emph{virasamāya}.) Dangerous? (\textbf{\ml{അപകടകരമായ}}, \emph{apakaṭakaramāya}.) Flat? (\textbf{\ml{പരന്ന}}, \emph{paranna}.) Wrinkled? (\textbf{\ml{ചുളിഞ്ഞ}}, \emph{cuḷiñña}.) Steep? (\textbf{\ml{കുത്തനെയുള്ള}}, \emph{kuttaneyuḷḷa}.) Hollow? (\textbf{\ml{പൊള്ളയായ}}, \emph{poḷḷayāya}.) Faded? (\textbf{\ml{മങ്ങിയ}}, \emph{maṅṅiya}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 286-290 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R290-second-pass-words-from-chapters-286-290}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for socks and shoes.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item socks, shoes, a belt, a purse, a pocket
  \item a snack, a banana fritter, a papaya, an orange, an apple
  \item a parcel, a cheque, interest, an amount, a form
  \item a boy, an aunt, a niece, a mother-in-law, a father-in-law
  \item new clothes given for Onam, Kathakali, the tiger dance of Onam, a chenda drum, a pooram
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Socks? (\textbf{\ml{സോക്സ്}}, \emph{sōks}.) Shoes? (\textbf{\ml{ഷൂസ്}}, \emph{ṣūs}.) A belt? (\textbf{\ml{ബെൽറ്റ്}}, \emph{belṟṟŭ}.) A purse? (\textbf{\ml{പേഴ്സ്}}, \emph{pēḻsŭ}.) A pocket? (\textbf{\ml{പോക്കറ്റ്}}, \emph{pōkkaṟṟŭ}.) A snack? (\textbf{\ml{പലഹാരം}}, \emph{palahāraṁ}.) A banana fritter? (\textbf{\ml{പഴംപൊരി}}, \emph{paḻampori}.) A papaya? (\textbf{\ml{പപ്പായ}}, \emph{pappāya}.) An orange? (\textbf{\ml{ഓറഞ്ച്}}, \emph{ōṟañcŭ}.) An apple? (\textbf{\ml{ആപ്പിൾ}}, \emph{āppiḷ}.) A parcel? (\textbf{\ml{പാഴ്സൽ}}, \emph{pāḻsal}.) A cheque? (\textbf{\ml{ചെക്ക്}}, \emph{cekkŭ}.) Interest? (\textbf{\ml{പലിശ}}, \emph{paliśa}.) An amount? (\textbf{\ml{തുക}}, \emph{tuka}.) A form? (\textbf{\ml{ഫോം}}, \emph{phōṁ}.) A boy? (\textbf{\ml{ആൺകുട്ടി}}, \emph{āṇkuṭṭi}.) An aunt? (\textbf{\ml{അമ്മായി}}, \emph{ammāyi}.) A niece? (\textbf{\ml{മരുമകൾ}}, \emph{marumakaḷ}.) A mother-in-law? (\textbf{\ml{അമ്മായിയമ്മ}}, \emph{ammāyiyamma}.) A father-in-law? (\textbf{\ml{അമ്മായിയപ്പൻ}}, \emph{ammāyiyappan}.) New clothes given for Onam? (\textbf{\ml{ഓണക്കോടി}}, \emph{ōṇakkōṭi}.) Kathakali? (\textbf{\ml{കഥകളി}}, \emph{kathakaḷi}.) The tiger dance of Onam? (\textbf{\ml{പുലികളി}}, \emph{pulikaḷi}.) A chenda drum? (\textbf{\ml{ചെണ്ട}}, \emph{ceṇṭa}.) A pooram? (\textbf{\ml{പൂരം}}, \emph{pūraṁ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
